about: Every input the differential audit diff2-B2 (fix-b2 round 1 against origin/main) found regressed by the asked-life rule, high, medium and low (all but two lows, which stay as they are). A made-up life is read only when the founder's own message asks about the coach's own weekend, day, week, holiday, evening or plans; never a question the founder reports from someone else ('my manager always asks how was your weekend'), wants words for ('draft my reply', 'how do I answer') or plays ('roleplay: …'), never the founder's own plans ('should I make any plans for the weekend?') or a market's season ('How was Christmas for retailers like us?'). Without 'rewritten' a case must come out exactly as origin/main left it: packages/ai/src/validators/asked-life.test.ts checks the reply rewrite (typed and spoken) and the sentence gate (typed and on a call) with the founder's message against the same without it, and evals/tests/test_matrix_checks.py checks the matrix presence check (G14) against main's verdict 'g14'. 'rewritten' is what the reply becomes where the founder did ask and the reply made a life up: only the made-up clause goes when the rest of its sentence answers the founder's news ('Mine was quiet — but I'm so sorry about your mom.' → 'I'm so sorry about your mom.'), a bare 'You?' is said in full, and G14 fails the reply and passes 'rewritten'.
